def transform(grid):
    # Crop to the colored pattern's bounding box; concatenate a copy for every 4 marker.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    n = sum(v == 4 for row in grid for v in row)
    return [[v for _ in range(n) for v in row] for row in pattern]
